title: Thai actor Win Metawin shares what makes Filipino fans ‘memorable’
summary: Thai celebrity Metawin “Win” Opas-iamkajorn expressed appreciation for Filipino fans as he returned to Manila on Tuesday, highlighting their energy as among the things that make them memorable.
